page_title: BHA 2-1 MNU | Brighton v Manchester Utd 24/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.

90+5' 2 - 1 It's a goal! Joao Pedro (Brighton) bursts into the box to get on the end of a whipped in cross from Simon Adingra and scores magnificently from close range into the left side of the goal. 2:1.
90+5' Julio Enciso (Brighton) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
90+4' Brighton will have a chance to score from a corner kick. Julio Enciso (Brighton) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
90+4' Julio Enciso (Brighton) has a good chance to get on the scoresheet and fires the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
90+2' Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Craig Pawson blows his whistle for an infringement.
90+1' Scott McTominay (Manchester United) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
90' We are about to witness a substitution. Antony (Manchester United) is replacing Amad Diallo.
90' Fabian Hurzeler decides to make a substitution. Kaoru Mitoma will be replaced by Simon Adingra (Brighton).
90' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Georginio Rutter (Brighton) replaces Yankuba Minteh.
90' Here is a change. Billy Gilmour is going off and Fabian Hurzeler gives the last tactical orders to Yasin Ayari (Brighton).
89' Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Craig Pawson had an easy-decision to make.
85' The resulting corner from Amad Diallo (Manchester United) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

85' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. Manchester Utd will have a chance to score from a corner.
83' The corner from Billy Gilmour (Brighton) is intercepted by Andre Onana.
83' Brighton take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. Brighton get a corner.
82' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Brighton will take a corner kick.
82' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Craig Pawson blows for a foul.
81' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
79' It's time for a substitution. Matthijs de Ligt (Manchester United) comes on in place of Harry Maguire.
79' Erik ten Hag has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Scott McTominay (Manchester United) replacing Bruno Fernandes.
79' Substitution. Danny Welbeck will be replaced by Julio Enciso (Brighton).
78' Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
77' The goalkeeper is not tested by the free kick from the edge of the box by Billy Gilmour (Brighton) as his effort only hit the wall.
76' Craig Pawson shows a yellow card to Amad Diallo (Manchester United) for his blatant foul.
73' Here comes a substitution. Carlos Baleba (Brighton) is brought on as a substitute for James Milner.
72' The goal by Manchester Utd is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
72' Wait! Referee Craig Pawson has indicated he is going to review the Manchester Utd goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
70' Goal! Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) finishes from close range with an easy finish and he makes it 1:2. He was ably assisted there by Alejandro Garnacho.
69' The total number of attempts is 6:7.
67' Casemiro (Manchester United) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar.
65' It is time for a substitution. Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) is on for Marcus Rashford.
63' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Craig Pawson to decide. The relieved Manchester Utd players can finally celebrate.
62' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Manchester Utd players aren’t happy.

60' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Amad Diallo (Manchester United) displays superb quick feet and dribbling as he jinks his way through multiple challenges and takes a shot from inside the box, which is deflected and goes past stranded Jason Steele. 1:1.

59' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) shows good awareness inside the box as he latches on to a cross from the resulting free kick. He jumps high but his towering header lacks a little bit of accuracy and glances off the crossbar.
58' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) is penalised for holding. Craig Pawson signals a set piece.
57' The linesman signals that Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
56' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the roof of the net is denied by a decent save from Andre Onana.
53' The defender bravely blocks the shot from James Milner (Brighton) inside the box.
51' James Milner (Brighton) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

50' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. Corner kick. Brighton will have an opportunity.
49' Great teamplay by Manchester Utd as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
46' James Milner (Brighton) fires the ball towards goal from just outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar after coming very close to hitting the roof of the net.
46' Erik ten Hag makes a half-time substitution. Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) comes on in place of Mason Mount.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Craig Pawson blows for a foul.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
41' The ball possession at the moment is 45:55.
38' The game is interrupted as Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is flagged offside.
37' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

36' Mason Mount (Manchester United) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted. Manchester Utd have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
35' The Manchester Utdplayers are livid after referee Craig Pawson signals NO GOAL after the VAR review!
34' Wait! Referee Craig Pawson immediately makes the VAR signal, most likely to see if there was an offside in the build-up play.
34' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
32' 1 - 0 Danny Welbeck (Brighton) received a delightful pass inside the box before slotting the ball past the goalkeeper. What a brilliant finish!
31' Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) is adjudged offside.
30' Dangerous play by Marcus Rashford (Manchester United). Craig Pawson blows his whistle for a foul.
28' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) tries his luck and hits a thunderbolt of a shot towards goal from long range, but his powerful strike goes narrowly wide of the left post.
27' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

27' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The ball is out of play and Manchester Utd manage to earn a corner.
24' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Manchester Utd due to an offside in the build-up play.
24' Casemiro (Manchester United) finds himself some space around the penalty spot to connect with a fine free kick. His header is slightly mistimed and sails inches over the bar.
23' Attention! Referee Craig Pawson straight away wants to review previous situation with VAR, presumably for a possible offside in the build-up.
23' Joel Veltman (Brighton) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
19' The Brighton players are exchanging some short passes.
16' Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United) makes a strong challenge and Craig Pawson blows for a foul.
14' Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Craig Pawson blows his whistle for a foul.
12' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) latches on to a lofted pass and strikes the ball! His attempt flies narrowly wide of the right post.
10' Joao Pedro (Brighton) has a sight of goal and shoots from long range but his ambitious effort flies just wide of the right post.
8' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
7' The resulting corner from Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is cleared by the defence.
6' The game is interrupted. Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
5' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jason Steele intercepts the ball.
3' Manchester Utd control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Manchester Utd will have the kick-off.
Craig Pawson got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
